pr151.body:
Continue the eight-task research program using actual 64-core/125-GiB NCP calculations and pinned PR150/HE64/HH89/CR71 inputs.

Unit1 is committed on this branch: 56 solver receipts (53 accepted finite-model calculations, 3 preserved failures), bounded nuclear/cascade/inventory/source calculations, and independent review. Its raw archive was verified on Drive and Dropbox; see UNIT1_DELIVERY.json.

Unit2 has now completed the balanced 2e/3e DZ projections, core-valence atomic extension through QZ, SCF/backend repairs, molecular refinements, and 128-step projected response. The combined snapshot contains 83 solver receipts: 77 accepted finite-model calculations and 6 failed/deferred attempts. Independent review checked all 24 newly accepted NPZ files and their saved-array/numerical identities.

Actual NCP Rust verification: rustc1.99.0 and cargo1.99.0; locked offline native-library check succeeded; all8 deuterium_atomic integration tests passed. An earlier library-only filter ran zero tests and is not counted.

Unit2 deliverables are available independently of the pending source-commit step:
- [English PDF report, 10pages](https://www.dropbox.com/preview/bianchi/rei_bianchi/research/microphysics_r9_20261015/REPORT_EN.pdf)
- [LaTeX source](https://www.dropbox.com/scl/fi/y2o5mtq649m5jc5qb0zlj)
- [Full Unit2 source, raw arrays, receipts and reviews,43,479,461bytes](https://www.dropbox.com/preview/BASS_DERIVATION_DOSSIERS_20260912/REIONIZATION_R9_UNIT2_CORRELATED_RUST_20261015.tar.gz)

Publication snapshot: the Unit2 Dropbox archive is confirmed. The last observed background step was the Drive archive upload; its verification and subsequent Git commit have not yet been confirmed. The remote-command connector reached its monthly usage limit, so no further direct NCP commands were issued. The existing upload/publisher process was not stopped. A conditional collector was launched for the still-running large Li/Be union augTZ case; any returned raw result remains subject to independent review.

Physical limits remain explicit: core-valence ionization T-to-Q change3.49970822e-4Eh and He/Li projection change2.72459345e-4 both miss their selected targets. Response TRK values1.11125914/1.65647443 remain below3 despite Krylov convergence. BO curves are not reaction rates, conditional BBN/source maps are not evolved cosmological trajectories, and all8 full physical programmes remain open.

Changes are additive under research/microphysics_r9_20261015. The existing checkout branch and unrelated work are preserved. No merge or production activation.

README.md.text:
# R9 NCP microphysics research loop

This additive research package continues the eight-job program against rei_bianchi PR150 commit54dd5352672127e77970eb06f3dda027f2aee275. It contains actual NCP calculations, not merely launch instructions. The full eight-job physical project is not closed.

## Unit1 completed

On NCP hostname s1a0e5abed09 (64 logical CPUs,125GiB RAM), execute all-electron nonrelativistic finite-Gaussian FCI atomic targets, common-basis sudden projections, neutral LiH/LiHe ground-state Born-Oppenheimer curves with counterpoise, and bounded nuclear/cascade/inventory/source calculations. Full raw receipts and CI/RDM arrays are in the archive below.56 solver receipts include53 successful finite-model calculations and3 preserved failures; repairs are running as Unit2. The193 bridge checks and6 microphysics/backend/SCF tests passed on the actual NCP host. These are implementation checks, not complete-basis error bars.

## Physical interpretation

The Li-only contracted common basis gives He-to-Li+ ground survival.4672820372 at aug-DZ and.7167028695 at aug-TZ. This large change diagnoses an inadequate basis; do not use either as a converged physical probability. Balanced parent+daughter basis unions and Li-to-Be+ three-electron projections are Unit2.

At LiHe R=11.5a0, cc-DZ raw attraction changes to CP repulsion+5.5109086e-6Eh. A low-temperature reaction rate cannot be inferred from an unconverged ground-state curve. LiH aug-DZ R=3a0 has V_CP=-.0861078210Eh. Ionic/excited channels, couplings and nuclear scattering remain separate work.

The projected Li dipole response is a finite Gaussian pseudostate calculation, not a physical continuum cross section. BBN-to17 is a conservative inventory and conditional charge map, not an evolved recombination history. Nuclear anchor sensitivity is not a fitted posterior. E1 cascade shell mixtures contain physical line energies but no recombination injection weights or2s two-photon spectrum. Source moments are conditional on the declared50000K blackbody shape and reference photon flux.

Read the contracts, versioned code, review records and actual per-case receipts before promoting a result. Source versions remain immutable. Unit2 will add balanced-basis/core-correlation calculations, exact two-electron treatment above the64-orbital bitstring limit, dissociation SCF-initializer repairs and128-step projected response.

## Unit2 snapshot

83 archived solver receipts; 77 accepted finite-model calculations. See [English report](REPORT_EN.pdf), [LaTeX source](REPORT_EN.tex), [execution index](results/EXECUTION_INDEX.csv), and [convergence status](results/CONVERGENCE_STATUS.json).

Core-valence Li ionization I_Q=0.198041791435 Eh; T-to-Q change=0.00034997082 Eh exceeds the target. He/Li retained Q-space projection P=0.708668280218; its basis target remains unmet. NCP Rust1.99 locked offline crate check and8 deuterium integration tests passed. The report records the current large3e run status. All8 physical closure conditions remain open.

Verified Unit2 raw archive and standalone PDF/LaTeX backups are recorded in [UNIT2_DELIVERY.json](UNIT2_DELIVERY.json). [PDF download](https://drive.google.com/file/d/15EuytSPKy9abpvJp2AJy7YrnrHQ6H5E4/view).
